sentences.en: During the presentation the speaker talked mainly about gender inequality.
sentences.zh: 在演讲中，发言人主要讨论了性别不平等的问题。

sentences.en: Climate change threatens to exacerbate existing social and economic inequalities.
sentences.zh: 气候变化威胁加剧现有的社会和经济不平等现象。

sentences.en: No inequality should be allowed to exist between men and women.
sentences.zh: 不应该允许男性和女性之间存在任何不平等。

senses.zh: 不平等，不均等,数不等式,变动，变化,不相同
